# FEA release-resource security finding anchor

GitHub Code Scanning results from FEA intentionally link to this public placeholder file, **not** to the actual distributed file. The scanner omits source paths and secret content from SARIF. Use the hash ID in a protected scan report, within your trusted build pipeline, to locate the affected resource.

This file is not evidence of a vulnerability in the FEA repository. A synthetic sample should not be confused with a real application scan.
